g.text: From pump telemetry to validated predictions and tool-grounded decisions
Validate + publish before release; bounded runs, separate cohorts
Distinct batch, stream and reference state; no lakehouse server
Bounded writers; acknowledged replay skips writes and does not renew TTL
Finalized window schema ≠ the predictor's eight rolling inputs
Bounded SDK jobs, not a daemon
Batch, stream and serving namespaces remain separate
Two executor Pods share the same physical CPU host
Google Cloud VMs · one K3s cluster
CPU server + GPU worker; VM-based, not GKE
Scoped AppRoles for gateway and CI
Grafana initiates queries; arrows show returned data
Schema · event/arrival times · machine state · demo lease · exact model/run/data/threshold pin
404 unknown · 422 malformed · 409 stopped · 503 stale / invalid / unavailable
Report + policy + persistent state; candidate only, no automatic promotion
RAG & AGENTS · verified reference state + live machine facts
Specialist results → coordinator → controller / UI. Check actual child status and MCP facts; Completed alone is insufficient.
gVisor WorkerPools scaled 2 → 4 → 2 per role on one CPU host. More Pods do not establish host-level HA.
D Data · S Stream · F Features · O Orchestration · Q Governance · T Training · C Delivery · I Infrastructure · V Secrets
P Prediction · A Agent tasks · K Knowledge · M Tool/query paths · G Generation · H/L Telemetry. Crossings without a node do not join.
Authored architecture · simulated equipment · recorded deployment boundaries
Moving markers show direction with independent arbitrary timing. Open the HTML viewer for source references and detailed views.
